violation_type.title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval (26 TAC §744.2911(1))
violation_type.short_title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has failed to provide written approval from the fire marshal to provide care above ground level.

finding_variants.text: The operation has failed to provide written approval from the fire marshal to provide care above ground level.
Due to the layout of the building there are some areas that may be considered to be on the upper level. The permit holder has contacted the fire marshall and is pending clarification.

During the inspection at the program children were present and engaging in activites on the second level of the facility without written fire marshal approval. The director did relocate the children to another area of the facility during the inspection and the children will no longer be present on the second level until the fire marshal gives the approval.
The operation was caring for children upstairs without written fire marshal approval.
I observe group of children ages four to nine year old playing on the second floor. Note: corrected when children were moved to first floor.
